## Summary

**Root cause:** The Deployment's readiness probe requested `GET /readyz` on port 80, but the container runs stock `nginx:1.31.5`, whose default config only serves static files at `/` (`/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html`). The kubelet events confirmed the failure:

```
Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404
```

Because all 3 pods failed readiness, the `app` Service had **zero ready endpoints** (EndpointSlice entries showed `ready=false, serving=false`; the v1 Endpoints object had only `notReadyAddresses`), so traffic to the ClusterIP had no backend.

**Fix (minimal, persistent owner):** Patched only the Deployment's readiness probe path to a path nginx actually serves:

```
kubectl patch deployment app -n default --type=json \
  -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe/httpGet/path","value":"/"}]'
```

Replicas (3), image (`nginx:1.31.5`), port (80), and Service selector/targetPort were left unchanged.

**Verified outcome (fresh observations):**
- Deployment: `replicas=3 updated=3 ready=3 available=3`, conditions `Available=True (MinimumReplicasAvailable)` and `Progressing=True (NewReplicaSetAvailable)` — requested count matches updated/ready/available.
- Pods: all three `1/1 Running`, 0 restarts.
- Endpoints: `app` now resolves to `10.244.0.8:80, 10.244.0.9:80, 10.244.0.10:80`; every EndpointSlice address reports `ready=true serving=true`.
- Actual request through the Service from an in-cluster client: `http://app/ -> 200` and `http://app.default.svc.cluster.local/ -> 200`, body `<title>Welcome to nginx!</title>`. The temporary verification pod was deleted (NotFound confirms cleanup).
- Probe path is now `/`; probe `port=80` and `http` container port were already correct, so no other field changed.
